facts.fact: The University of Cape Town says its African Compute Initiative, funded under the GBP 58 million AI4D programme of the UK FCDO and Canada's IDRC, will build a GPU cluster for AI research in UCT's High Performance Computing Data Centre, targeted to be operational within 12 months.

systems.platform: GPU servers, multi-petabyte storage, OpenStack and Ceph
OpenStack and Ceph; more than 600 active users
systems.owner: Inter-University Institute for Data Intensive Astronomy (IDIA), UCT

note: The ACI is planned with targets (100 users in year one, 300 across five institutions by year three), not in service; ilifu is a research cloud not described as AI computing.
